query:
Two members pushed back on Dani's ridgeline proposal and both seemed to prefer easier terrain. Who brought up the social element of hiking as a reason to go with the flatter route?

Options:
A. Bev
B. Dani
C. Marcus
D. Yusuf
context:
[1] (about=Bev, core, t2 @2025-03-10T16:51:00) Concerned about social side of group being overshadowed by challenging hikes.
[2] (about=Bev, core, t0 @2025-03-03T19:12:00) Needs to know about tea/cafe availability before committing to a hike.
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Bev, group-interaction, t8 @2025-03-31T18:52:00) Group leans toward woodland route over exposed ridge for late August hike; Dani conditionally agrees.
[4] (about=Cass, core, t4 @2025-03-17T18:28:00) Knows that ground nesters fail if walkers cut through during nesting season; can send NatureEngland note.
[5] (about=Dani, core, t0 @2025-03-03T19:12:00) Prefers challenging hikes like Heron Ridgeline; wants to push the group.
[6] (about=Dani, core, t4 @2025-03-17T18:28:00) Does not want to reroute a whole hike for skylarks; thinks they cope fine with walkers.
[7] (about=Dani, core, t5 @2025-03-24T19:05:00) Proposes a big hike in October in the Cairngorms, pending transport.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Dani, group-interaction, t0 @2025-03-03T19:12:00) Dani plans a proper ridgeline hike for next month.
[9] (about=Yusuf, core, t8 @2025-03-31T18:52:00) A woodland route with solid gain exists; they are less fashionable than exposed ridges.
